name: Elvis
desc: A rhinestone-jumpsuit rock'n'roll king with pompadour, sideburns and shades who swivels his hips, croons into the mic, kicks and karate-chops and points to the crowd on the beat — rendered as spotlit chiaroscuro noir, CMYK halftone pop-print, Vegas neon outline or pure backlit silhouette.

pose.doc: pose preset; auto = section-driven medley per act

style.doc: aesthetic: spotlit chiaroscuro / CMYK halftone print / Vegas neon outline / backlit pure silhouette

act.doc: multi-minute pose dramaturgy used when pose=auto
